title: AG60053: Fishery Biology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Principles of Taxonomy, Classification and Nomenclature; Species Concept,
External Morphology of Culturable Fin-Fishes, Shell- fishes and Other
Commercially Important Aquatic Organisms, Anatomical Features and Physiological
Systems of Fish and Prawn. Ecology and Aquatic Eco-systems - Freshwater and
Marine. Techniques of Artificial Propagation of Different Organisms of
Fisheries Importance. Different Culture Techniques in Freshwater, Brackishwater
and Seawater - Composite Fish Culture, Prawn Culture, Mariculture, Cage and Pen
Culture, Intensive Fish Culture etc. Recycling of Waste Through Aquaculture and
Integrated Aquaculture.
